name: embedded-agent-app-roadmap
title: Embedded Agent App Roadmap
description: Define an App-first embedded Agent client roadmap using Codex App Server sessions, CanISend MCP tools, a simplified Workbench, and an evidence-based Tauri-versus-Electron gate
creator: pengjiaxin
notes: The owner approved the converged roadmap and R0 implementation on 2026-09-04. R0 completed the direct Codex App Server/MCP authority reconciliation and clean Workspace v4 blocker; R1 implementation is under exact verification, while R2-R6 remain unstarted and require just-in-time child tasks and their own gates.

meta.proposed_mvp: R0-R4: clean Workspace v4, one Codex App Server session, CanISend MCP review loop, simplified Workbench, exact managed-file history, and bounded recovery
meta.proposed_protocols: Codex App Server stdio JSON-RPC for MVP sessions; MCP for CanISend tools; generic ACP v1 stdio with Claude Agent first after MVP
meta.post_mvp_agent_channel: R10/R5 generic ACP v1 stdio channel, first qualified with Claude Agent; per-agent capability and provenance gates; no initial registry auto-install
meta.approved_ux: conversation-centered Workbench with a contextual right Inspector
meta.support_stack: Rust 1.97 + Tauri 2 + Svelte 5/TypeScript/Vite; Node and pnpm remain build-time only
meta.traceability: body-free session/turn/tool correlation reusing CanISend operation, receipt, preview, revision, digest, and audit authorities
meta.git_boundary: Git tracks source, plans, tests, and release provenance; private Workspace content remains under the local revision/digest/audit authority
meta.file_versioning: exact append-only manifests for registered CanISend projection/export outputs, backed by the existing content-addressed BlobStore
meta.diff_engine: two-stage on-demand comparison in canisend-app using qualified similar 3.2.0 Myers hunks; no Workspace scan, Git runtime, temp files, or persisted patches
meta.verification_tier: focused per phase plus one final source gate after authority changes
meta.authority_state: approved; R0 complete; R1 verification in progress
